prompt: Analyze this text to determine if it was AI-generated: [formal academic text discussing AI detection, with mixed signals and acknowledged ambiguity]

assertions.name: Likelihood assessment acknowledges ambiguity (Medium or conditional)
assertions.description: The analysis should recognize that this text is ambiguous and could be either human or AI. Should NOT claim high confidence in either direction

assertions.name: Context-dependent signals recognized
assertions.description: Should acknowledge that formal academic writing legitimately has formal tone, consistent grammar, and technical vocabulary regardless of authorship

assertions.name: Confidence level is Low to Moderate
assertions.description: Should express low to moderate confidence (35-60%) since the signals are inconclusive in academic context

assertions.name: Caveats section addresses edge case nature
assertions.description: Should explicitly mention that formal/technical writing creates ambiguity and that this text could be either human expertise or sophisticated AI
